title: Day Two of the Broadway Festival had EVERYTHING: new musicals to fall...
transcript: Apparently the Broadway Festival had one singular goal in mind, and it was to make every theater kid in attendance lose their mind. And let me tell you, they succeeded. I had so much fun day one of the Broadway festival that my expectations were now sky high. We started the morning at a diner called the Broadway Lights, which was before heading to the festival grounds for the day. We wanted to catch the 80s jukebox. We were already a little bit late. We can literally hear people bolting their faces off as we were walking in. Luckily though, we got to see Lena Hall and the most insane Kelly O'hara performance ever. She was literally rapping with Renee Alice Gouldsbury. I love them. I grabbed some Broadway themed lemonade before heading over to what I did for likes, which was the TikTok show. Oh, so many of my favorite internet friends just showing off how insanely talented they were. I truly was just losing it over them. We stayed for about half of it because we were running to the main stage for the new musical preview. I love getting a little sneak peek at New shows like bloodline and Odyssey. Inspired hip hop musical Betty, who showed up to play a couple of songs from there our new musical. I just love learning about what's coming, getting to see workshops, just putting things on my radar. Plus we got previews of Regency Girls and Huzzah! Two shows I've been curious about since they premiered regionally, and now I'm very hyped for dinner. We grabbed the same Mac and cheese as we did yesterday. It was very good. And wandered back to the main stage for Jason Robert Brown and friends. Like so many theater kids, Jerry's music is just hardwired into my DNA. We got to hear so many of my favorite songs, including Western Wall from the connector, and Norbert Leo but showed up and saying if I didn't believe in you. And I cried. This is my first cry of the day. Lots more to come. I thought we had peaked, but things were just getting started because it was time for the event that I was most excited for, the rent 30th anniversary. I genuinely need time to process this because it was so incredible. I got to scream sing Love You Bohemian with nearly the entire original broadcast of Rent. Teenage me would simply never recover. Adult me too. A full video is coming, but I'll leave you with this for we had a few minutes to grab some ice cream and then rolled straight into Saturday night. The big show theme of day two. Day one. I was so blown away by this, and day two, equally blown away. The mashups, the medleys, the performances. Kelli O'hara sang light in the Piazza and Bridges. Norbert Leo Butz sang Big Fish, Jenna Colella sang me in the sky. Got a sneak peek from Wanted Matt Rodin saying not getting married. Then Renee Alice Goldsberry gave us a whole Lion King and Hamilton set to finish the evening. Or I should say the show, because the evening was not done. We still had Matt's campfire. And when I tell you this was the ultimate theatre fever dream. We sang, we cried. I honestly mostly watched Jenna Ushkowitz cause she has the best reactions. She's truly one of us. I cannot believe the festival ends tomorrow. I am genuinely so upset about it. This has been the most special weekend and I cannot wait to see what's in store for us on day three.
classificationReason: Festival recap covering multiple performances: 80s jukebox show, TikTok talent show, new musical previews (Bloodline, Odyssey, Betty). No single stage production is the focus.
